sql:
WITH considered_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, o.gross_cents
  FROM orders_dv_agg_00 o
  WHERE o.status = 'paid'
    AND o.currency = 'EUR'
    AND o.gross_cents <> 0
),
order_refunds AS (
  SELECT co.order_id, co.account_id, co.gross_cents,
         COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents
  FROM considered_orders co
  LEFT JOIN refunds_dv_agg_00 r
    ON r.order_id = co.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY co.order_id, co.account_id, co.gross_cents
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COUNT(orf.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(orf.gross_cents), 0) AS gross_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(orf.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents,
       COALESCE(SUM(orf.gross_cents), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(orf.refund_cents), 0) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(orf.gross_cents), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(orf.refund_cents), 0) * 100.0 / SUM(orf.gross_cents), 6)
       END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM accounts_dv_agg_00 a
LEFT JOIN order_refunds orf ON orf.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.region = 'east'
GROUP BY a.account_id
HAVING COUNT(orf.order_id) > 0
ORDER BY a.account_id

WITH qualifying_orders AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, o.gross_cents
  FROM orders_dv_agg_01 o
  WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'settled')
    AND o.currency = 'USD'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM refunds_dv_agg_01 r
      WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'posted'
    )
),
order_refunds AS (
  SELECT q.order_id, q.account_id, q.gross_cents,
         COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_cents), 0) AS refund_cents
  FROM qualifying_orders q
  LEFT JOIN refunds_dv_agg_01 r
    ON r.order_id = q.order_id AND r.refund_status = 'posted'
  GROUP BY q.order_id, q.account_id, q.gross_cents
)
SELECT a.account_id,
       COUNT(o.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       SUM(o.gross_cents) AS gross_cents,
       SUM(o.refund_cents) AS refund_cents,
       SUM(o.gross_cents) - SUM(o.refund_cents) AS net_cents,
       CASE WHEN SUM(o.gross_cents) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ROUND(SUM(o.refund_cents) * 100.0 / SUM(o.gross_cents), 6)
       END AS refund_rate_pct
FROM accounts_dv_agg_01 a
INNER JOIN order_refunds o ON o.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.region = 'west'
GROUP BY a.account_id
ORDER BY a.account_id

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT s.entity_id, s.event_id, s.event_time, s.seq, s.status
  FROM status_events_dv_latest_00 s
  WHERE s.event_time < '2025-01-13 12:00:00'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    e.entity_id,
    r.status,
    r.event_time,
    r.seq,
    r.rn
  FROM entities_dv_latest_00 e
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      entity_id,
      status,
      event_time,
      seq,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY entity_id
        ORDER BY event_time DESC, seq ASC, event_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM eligible
  ) r ON r.entity_id = e.entity_id AND r.rn = 1
)
SELECT entity_id, status, event_time, seq
FROM ranked
ORDER BY entity_id ASC

sql:
WITH first_view AS (
  SELECT person_id, MIN(event_time) AS view_at
  FROM funnel_events_dv_funnel_00
  WHERE event_type = 'view'
    AND event_time >= '2025-01-11 00:00:00'
    AND event_time < '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY person_id
), first_cart AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, MIN(e.event_time) AS cart_at
  FROM funnel_events_dv_funnel_00 e
  JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'add_to_cart'
    AND e.event_time >= v.view_at
    AND e.event_time < '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY e.person_id
), first_purchase AS (
  SELECT e.person_id, MIN(e.event_time) AS purchase_at
  FROM funnel_events_dv_funnel_00 e
  JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = e.person_id
  WHERE e.event_type = 'purchase'
    AND e.event_time >= v.view_at
    AND e.event_time < '2025-01-13 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY e.person_id
)
SELECT
  p.person_id,
  v.view_at,
  c.cart_at,
  x.purchase_at,
  CASE WHEN v.view_at IS NOT NULL AND x.purchase_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS converted
FROM people_dv_funnel_00 p
LEFT JOIN first_view v ON v.person_id = p.person_id
LEFT JOIN first_cart c ON c.person_id = p.person_id
LEFT JOIN first_purchase x ON x.person_id = p.person_id
ORDER BY p.person_id;
